WITH state_bases AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(c.state_county_province), '') AS state_key,
         COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_base
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(c.state_county_province), '')
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(account_base) AS total_base FROM state_bases
),
shares AS (
  SELECT s.state_key,
         s.account_base,
         s.account_base * 1.0 / t.total_base AS share
  FROM state_bases s
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
),
above AS (
  SELECT sh.account_base,
         sh.share,
         sh.share - av.avg_share AS excess
  FROM shares sh
  CROSS JOIN avg_share av
  WHERE sh.share > av.avg_share
)
SELECT SUM(account_base) AS combined_account_base,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(excess) AS average_excess_over_mean
FROM above;
